description: One word for each thing the tool names, in every surface (Studio, chat, posting guide, docs). Skills and scripts say 'use'; a test (tests/unit/py/test_glossary.py) fails when a shipped Arabic text contains one of the 'avoid' forms. Arabic text names Instagram in Latin letters, as orthography.md section 9 says for every brand and tool name.

brandBook.note: The approved document of a brand; Brand Home is the page that holds it.

style.note: A preset and everything that restyles a post. «النمط» alone means a hook pattern in the hook-engine text and is not covered by this term.

slide.note: Masculine in every dialect: السلايد الثاني، التالي، السابق، الحالي، الأول.

caption.note: «التعليق» means a comment under the post; never use it for the caption.

instagram.note: Latin in Arabic text. The orthography lint offers the same fix for the Arabic spellings.

mythFact.note: The two labels printed on a myth-fact slide, both without the article.

ellipsisBeat.note: The single character, never three dots (ORTHO-PUNCT-005).
